lifecycle.detail: Request timed out with no settlement response observed.

diagnosis.title: The payment may have been authorized without the resource arriving
diagnosis.explanation: The authorization was submitted and no settlement response came back. From the client's side there is no way to tell whether the merchant received and held a valid authorization or never received it at all. Both look identical from here.
diagnosis.guidance: Do not retry this request. The merchant may hold a valid authorization, and a retry can result in paying twice. Check the settlement status on-chain or with the merchant before issuing another request; tx402's EXPOSE fence is what keeps this state durable rather than silently retried.
